name: foundry-hosted
description: A Microsoft Foundry hosted agent: a per-session, VM-isolated Linux sandbox running the agent's container, with a persistent $HOME, its own Entra agent identity, and the tools of the project's toolbox (reached as one MCP endpoint). It serves Responses turns; nobody is sitting at a terminal.

tools.code_interpreter: run Python code in the toolbox's sandbox: compute, transform data, make files and charts; install packages from public registries for the current session only
tools.web_search: search the public web through the toolbox
tools.web_fetch: fetch public web pages and unauthenticated public APIs
tools.search: query a connected Azure AI Search index through the toolbox
tools.mcp: call a tool of an MCP server connected through the toolbox
tools.openapi: call an operation of an OpenAPI service connected through the toolbox, with the connection's credential
tools.a2a: delegate a task to another agent connected through the toolbox (Agent-to-Agent)
tools.read: read files under $HOME, persisted per session
tools.write: create and overwrite files under $HOME, persisted per session

lacks: a shell or terminal tool, unless the agent code registers one
user conversation outside the current Responses turn (no question can be asked and answered mid-turn)
credentials other than the connections declared in azure.yaml (no secrets in environment variables, no personal accounts)
public internet when the project is network-isolated (AllowOnlyApprovedOutbound)
Windows or macOS, and their GUI toolchains
